DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域講座の運営を手伝えるとのお話ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You mentioned that you can help run the community class.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 講座中の受付はできますが、終わったら子どもを迎えに行きます。片づけまで参加できるとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付可能だが子迎えで片づけ不能と時間制約を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can staff reception during the class, but afterward I have to pick up my child. I can't say I can stay through cleanup.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you can staff reception but cannot help clean up because of picking up your child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 終了前までに済む仕事をご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You'd like work that can be finished before the class ends, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。受け付ける人数を数える役ならできます。机を片づける人の数へ私を入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人数集計を希望し片づけ人数から外すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I can count the people we check in. Please don't include me in the number of people putting away the tables.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to count attendees and to be excluded from the cleanup headcount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付の記録は、どなたへ引き継げますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Who can you hand the reception records over to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 終了後も残る田中さんへ渡せます。田中さん本人に引継ぎの時間を確認してから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 田中本人へ引継ぎ時刻を先確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can give them to Tanaka, who will stay after the class. I'd like to confirm the handover time with Tanaka personally before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to confirm the handover time with Tanaka personally first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 田中さんへ、開始前に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check with Tanaka before the class starts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 田中さんが、講座終了時に人数の紙を受け取ると返事をくれました。受付を終えたら紙を渡し、確認してもらってから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 田中了承後に集計紙の受渡し確認して帰ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Tanaka has replied that they'll receive the attendance sheet at the end of the class. After finishing reception, I'll give them the sheet and leave once they've checked it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After Tanaka agrees, decide to hand over the attendance sheet, have it checked, and then leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 作業の途中で離れる場合も、担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you leave in the middle of the work, please also tell the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 迎えの時間が早まった時は、紙を机に置いて帰らず担当へ知らせます。今日は受付だけの役でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 早期退出時も紙放置せず担当へ知らせ受付役のみ確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: If the pickup time becomes earlier, I won't just leave the sheet on the desk and go; I'll tell the person in charge. Please assign me only reception today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm a reception-only role and say that even if leaving early, you will notify the person in charge instead of abandoning the sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その分担で承りました。ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've noted that arrangement. Thank you for your help. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入院の持ち物について、ご家族とご相談中ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you discussing what to bring for your hospital stay with your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母が何でも買ってくれると言いますが、普段使う物を持ってきたいです。何が必要か聞いてから母へ頼みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族の購入前に入院必要物を聞き普段品を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mother says she'll buy anything for me, but I'd like to bring the things I normally use. I want to ask what's needed before asking her for help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what is needed for hospitalization before your family buys things, and express a preference for your usual belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの持ち物の案内を、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check this guide to what you should bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 洗面用品がありますね。香りの強い物が苦手なので、家で使っている物を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 洗面用品案内と強い香りが苦手という嗜好を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see toiletries listed. I don't like strong scents, so I'd prefer the products I use at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention the toiletries guide and your dislike of strong scents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ち込みの条件が気になる物は、担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can ask the person in charge about any items whose conditions for bringing them concern you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自宅の物で使えるか確認します。母には高い物を買うほど助かるという意味ではないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持込条件確認後に高価品希望ではないと母へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check whether I can use my things from home. I'll tell my mother I don't mean that buying more expensive things would be more helpful.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After checking the conditions for bringing items, tell your mother you are not asking for expensive products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身で扱いやすい物についても、お伝えいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also tell us what is easy for you to handle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ふたを片手で開けられる小さい容器に慣れています。大きなセットを選ぶより、その希望を母へ話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 扱いやすい片手開閉容器を大セットより優先すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm used to small containers whose lids I can open with one hand. Rather than choosing a large set, I'll tell my mother that preference.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you prioritize easy-to-handle containers that open with one hand over large sets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご家族に渡す案内は、もう一部必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you need another copy of the guide to give your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: もう一部お願いします。必要な物は案内で、私の香りや容器の好みは別のメモで伝えて準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族用案内一部を求め必要物と本人嗜好を分けて準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: One more, please. I'll prepare by using the guide to communicate the necessary items, and a separate note for my preferences about scents and containers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request a copy of the guide for your family and prepare by separating required items from personal preferences. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内をお渡しします。それでは、持ち物のご相談は担当へお寄せください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's the guide. Please contact the person in charge about what to bring. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 指輪が見当たらないとのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a ring you can't find.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手を洗う時に外して、どこへ置いたか分からなくなりました。排水口へ入ったと決める前に、洗面台の周りを探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手洗いで外した指輪が不明で排水落下と断定せず探したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took it off to wash my hands, and now I don't know where I put it. Before deciding it went down the drain, I'd like to search around the washbasin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the ring removed for handwashing is missing and you want to search without concluding it fell down the drain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらの施設で外しましたか。管理する方へは伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: At which facility did you remove it? Have you told the person managing it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 職場の洗面室です。管理担当へ伝えたら、勝手に排水の部分を外さず待ってと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 職場管理へ連絡済みで排水部を自己解体せず待つと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: In the washroom at work. I told the facilities manager, and they asked me to wait without taking the drain parts apart on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have contacted workplace management and will wait without dismantling the drain yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 施設での確認状況と、指輪の特徴を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me about the checks at the facility and the ring's features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀色で、内側に二つの文字があります。文字は他の人へ広めず、照合する時に担当へ示したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銀指輪の内文字を公開せず照合担当へ示す希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's silver-colored, with two characters on the inside. I don't want those characters shared with other people; I'd like to show them to the person checking a match.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to show the silver-colored ring's inner characters to the person identifying it without making them public. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の写真などはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have your own photo or something similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外側の写真があります。内側は写っていないので、二つの文字は自分が覚えている情報として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外観写真と内文字の記憶を別資料として説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a photo of the outside. The inside isn't pictured, so I'll report the two characters as information I remember myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the exterior photo and your memory of the inner characters as separate sources. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 探している途中の結果も、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the results while the search is ongoing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。職場へ戻って管理担当の確認を聞きます。見つかるまでは、排水口に落とした事実があるようには話しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 職場確認を聞き落下未目撃を維持すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll return to work and ask what the facilities manager has checked. Until it's found, I won't talk as if it were an established fact that I dropped it down the drain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask about the workplace checks and maintain that you did not witness it fall. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況を伺いました。特徴を担当へ確認しますので、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've heard the circumstances. I'll check the features with the person in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送の控えについて、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about your dispatch receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この小さい数字が読みにくいので、問い合わせる番号を大きく書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小字控えの問合番号を大きく記すよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. These small digits are hard to read. Could you write the inquiry number in large print?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the inquiry number on the small-print receipt to be written in large print. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号の部分を確認します。こちらの数字を別の紙へ大きく書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the number section and write these digits in large print on a separate sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。私も一文字ずつ見て、元の控えと同じか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別紙転記を求め原控えと一文字ずつ照合したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I'd also like to look at it one character at a time and check that it matches the original receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request transcription onto a separate sheet and say you want to compare each character with the original. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらに書きました。番号を区切って読み上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've written it here. I'll read the number aloud in groups.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 読み上げと見比べられました。途中の八を三と読んでいたので、ここを確認できて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 読上げと字形を照合し八三の見間違いを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I could compare it with what you read aloud. I had been reading an eight in the middle as a three, so checking that was helpful.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare the spoken number with the written shapes and confirm the misreading of eight as three. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大きく写した紙は、この控えと一緒にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the large-print sheet together with this receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二枚を一緒にします。元の控えを捨てず、問い合わせの時は元の紙も手元で見られるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二枚を一緒に保存し元控えを捨てず照会時保持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll keep the two together. I won't discard the original receipt, and I'll have it available to look at when making an inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the two sheets together, do not discard the original, and keep it on hand for inquiries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今、配達状況も確認なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you also like to check the delivery status now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は番号を読めるようにしたかっただけです。大きい紙を受け取り、家で確認するときに使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日は配達照会でなく可読化希望のみと伝え大字紙受領する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I only wanted to make the number readable. I'll take the large-print sheet and use it when checking at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that today's request is only for readability, not a delivery inquiry, and receive the large-print sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号の確認ができましたね。それでは、二枚をお忘れなくお持ち帰りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've confirmed the number, then. Please don't forget to take both sheets home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この預金の説明に、分かりにくい言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any terms in this deposit explanation that are hard to understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族へ説明を持ち帰りたいです。この例の「元本十万円」と「利息」の欄の違いを、先に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族説明用に例示元本十万と利息欄の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to take the explanation home to my family. First, please tell me the difference between “Principal: 100,000 yen” and the “Interest” field in this example.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the example's 100,000-yen principal and interest field to explain to your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この例で元本は、もとにした預ける金額の十万円です。利息は、この預金で元本に対して付くお金です。具体額は資料の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this example, the principal is the original deposited amount of 100,000 yen. Interest is money added in relation to the principal under this deposit. We'll check the conditions in the documents for the actual amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 元本の十万円と、別の利息の欄ですね。家族に説明する時も、二つを同じ欄の数字として読まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元本と利息を別欄として読み説明すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The principal of 100,000 yen and a separate interest field, then. When explaining it to my family, I'll make sure not to read them as figures in the same field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will read and explain principal and interest as separate fields. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この資料の利息欄には、具体額ではなく条件を確認する項目が書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The interest field in this document lists conditions to check rather than a specific amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今ここで利息がいくらになると決まったわけではないのですね。条件を確かめる項目として、家族へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 利息額未確定で条件確認項目を家族へ伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: That means the interest amount hasn't been determined here now. I'll tell my family these are items for checking the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the interest amount is undetermined and you will explain the conditions-checking items to your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ち帰り用の説明を一部お渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can give you a copy of the explanation to take home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一部お願いします。元本の欄と、利息について次に聞く欄へ、それぞれ印を付けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料一部を求め元本欄と利息質問欄へ別に印を付ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: One copy, please. I'd like to mark the principal field and the field about interest that I need to ask about next, separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a copy and mark the principal field and interest-question field separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つの欄は、こちらです。資料をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: These are the two fields. Here's the document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。元本の意味を説明でき、利息の条件は質問として残せました。この資料で家族と読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料を受領し元本語義理解と利息条件の質問を残せたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received it. I can explain the meaning of principal, and have kept the interest conditions as questions. I'll read this document with my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that you received the document, understood the meaning of principal, and kept questions about the interest conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、資料をお役立てください。ご質問ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make use of the document. Thank you for your questions. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 料理会の材料をお選びですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you choosing ingredients for a cooking gathering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。丸ごとのかぼちゃを買いたいのですが、会場に大きい包丁があるか知らないので、先に担当へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 料理会の丸かぼちゃ切断道具が不明なので担当へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to buy a whole pumpkin, but I don't know whether there is a large knife at the venue, so I'll ask the organizer first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the organizer because you do not know whether there is equipment to cut a whole pumpkin at the cooking gathering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切ってある商品もあります。調理の場所と予定を確認してお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We also have cut products. Please choose after checking the cooking location and plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 担当から、小さい道具だけと返事が来ました。安いからと丸ごと買い、参加者へ無理に切ってもらうのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会場小道具のみと確認し丸購入で切断負担を押付けない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The organizer replied that they only have small utensils. I won't buy a whole one just because it's cheap and force participants to cut it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that only small utensils are available and do not impose cutting work on participants by buying a whole pumpkin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの切った商品は、重さがそれぞれ表示されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The weight is displayed on each of these cut pieces.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使う人数も聞きました。この二つの重さを合わせて足りるか、担当へ数字を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二切片の表示重量を合計し必要人数へ足りるか担当照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also asked how many people it will serve. I'll tell the organizer the weights to ask whether these two combined are enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add the labeled weights of the two pieces and ask the organizer whether it is enough for the number of people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どちらもお持ち帰りまでの保存表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please read the storage labels on both pieces for the journey home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当がこの量でよいと言っています。保存の表示を読み、会場へ行くまで自分の保冷袋へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 量了承後に保存表示を読み保冷袋で運ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The organizer says this amount is fine. I'll read the storage instructions and keep them in my own insulated bag until I get to the venue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After approval of the amount, say that you will read the storage label and transport it in an insulated bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの材料も、追加でお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are you also looking for any additional ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: かぼちゃは私の担当です。他の材料は別の人が準備するので重ねて買わず、この切った二つだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人担当はかぼちゃのみで他者材料を重複購入しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm responsible for the pumpkin. Someone else is preparing the other ingredients, so I won't duplicate their purchases; I'll just get these two cut pieces.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you are responsible only for pumpkin and will not duplicate ingredients prepared by others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、その二つをお選びください。お買物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please choose those two pieces, then. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 輪になって遊び始めるところですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're about to start playing in a circle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもが早く答えられるので、ほかの子の番まで答えてしまいそうです。私から順番を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 早答えできる子が他児の番も答えそうで親が順序説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My child can answer quickly, so they might answer even during other children's turns. I'll explain the turn order myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your child may answer on other children's turns because they answer quickly, and you will explain the order as the parent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一人ずつ考える時間を取る遊びです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This game gives each person time to think.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 正解を先に教えて勝つ遊びだと思っていました。自分の番以外は、口を出さず待つよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正解競争でなく他番では待つと子へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was a game you won by giving the right answer first. I'll tell my child to wait without interrupting when it isn't their turn.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tell your child this is not a race for correct answers and to wait during others' turns. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分からない子への助け方も、進行係へ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also discuss with the facilitator how to help a child who doesn't know the answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもは教えてあげたいと言っています。答えを言うより、助けがほしいか相手へ聞く方法を進行係に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 助けたい子の気持ちを示し相手希望を確認してヒントと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My child says they want to help. Rather than saying the answer, I'll ask the facilitator about a way to ask the other child whether they want help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your child's wish to help and discuss checking whether the other child wants help before giving hints. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの遊びでは、希望した時にヒントを出すよう進めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this game, we give hints when requested.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そのやり方を子どもへ話します。相手が考えている途中なら、うなずいて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希望時ヒントの方法を伝え考え中はうなずいて待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll explain that approach to my child. If the other child is still thinking, we'll nod and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the method of giving hints on request, and nod and wait while someone is thinking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後に点数を付ける予定はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We aren't planning to assign scores at the end.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 子どもが一番と決めるのではなく、みんなが自分の番で話せたことを一緒に喜びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 首位点数でなく全員の発話順達成を親子で喜ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Rather than deciding my child is number one, we'll celebrate together that everyone had a chance to speak on their own turn.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you and your child will celebrate everyone speaking in turn rather than top ranking or scores. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、順番に楽しみましょう。ご協力ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's enjoy taking turns, then. Thank you for your cooperation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様と経路のご確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking the route with your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週、子どもが初めて一人で帰ります。今日は私と一緒に、困った時に駅員さんへ言う言葉を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 来週初単独帰宅に備え本日は親子で困った時の言葉を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Next week my child will go home alone for the first time. Today, together, we'd like to check what to say to station staff if they have trouble.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that today you and your child want to check phrases for difficulties in preparation for their first solo trip home next week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今いる駅と、行き先は分かっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the station you're at now and your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 子どもは名前を言えます。私が先に答えるより、本人が行き先を話してから分からない部分を手伝います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人が行先発話して親は未理解部分だけ手伝う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My child can say the names. Instead of answering first myself, I'll let them say the destination and then help with anything they don't understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Let your child state the destination and help only with the parts they do not understand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 困った時は、無理に進まず係員へお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: If there is trouble, please ask a staff member instead of forcing yourself to continue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもへ、分からない時は「ここから帰りたい」と言ってよいと伝えます。今日は実際の切符を使って一緒に道を歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 分からない時の相談言葉を子に伝え今日は実券で同行確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell my child it's all right to say, “I want to go home from here,” when they don't know what to do. Today we'll walk the route together using an actual ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your child a phrase for asking when unsure, and check the route together today using a real ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 駅員へ見せる物も、本人が出せるようにしておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's also good to make sure your child can take out anything they need to show station staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 行き先を書いた紙を本人のかばんへ入れました。私の携帯だけに残すのでなく、子どもが見せられる形にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子本人が見せる行先紙を本人かばんへ準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I put a sheet with the destination written on it in my child's bag. Rather than keeping it only on my phone, I'll make it something my child can show.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare a destination sheet in your child's own bag that they can show themselves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日は、お二人で確認しながらお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Today, please proceed together while checking the route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は私が付き添い、本人が案内を読めた所を聞きます。一人で帰る前に、分からなかった所をもう一度一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は付き添い理解箇所を聞き未理解部分を再確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll accompany my child today and ask which parts of the signs they could read. Before they go home alone, we'll check the parts they didn't understand together again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will accompany your child today, ask about what they understood, and recheck the unclear parts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、親子でお気をつけて。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Have a safe trip together. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作品募集へお申し込みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you applying to the call for artwork?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣の人と一緒に作った切り絵を出したいです。申込欄が一人分なので、私だけの作品として出さない方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共同切り絵を本人単独作とせず一人欄への申込方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to submit a paper-cutting artwork I made with my neighbor. There is only room for one person's details on the form, so I'd like to ask how to submit without presenting it as mine alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to apply using a one-person field without treating a collaborative paper-cutting artwork as your sole work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 共同制作の扱いを、募集担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask the submissions coordinator how joint works are handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相手は絵を考え、私は切りました。全部私が作ったという紹介にはしたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手発案本人切断という実分担を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The other person designed the picture, and I cut it. I don't want it introduced as though I made the whole thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the actual division of work: the other person designed it and you cut it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 共同の名前を載せることについて、相手へ確認していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you checked with the other person about listing both your names?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 作品を出すことは了承してもらいました。名前の出し方はまだなので、そこも相手に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作品応募了承済みだが氏名掲載未確認と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: They agreed to submitting the work. We haven't discussed how to show the names yet, so I'll ask them about that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish agreement to submit the work from the unconfirmed permission to publish names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に相談する時、その区別もお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain that distinction too when consulting the coordinator.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。応募の了承と氏名の掲載の了承を別に伝え、名前を勝手に書き足しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二同意を分けて担当へ伝え無断名追記しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll explain permission to submit and permission to publish names separately, and won't add their name without asking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the coordinator about the two permissions separately and do not add a name without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 応募の条件を確認してから、用紙をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please fill out the form after checking the entry conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 条件を聞いたら相手と話します。共同制作として扱えない場合は、私の個人作品にして出すのでなく、今回は二人で出すか見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件確認後共同相手と再検討し個人作へ偽装しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: After hearing the conditions, I'll talk with the other person. If it can't be treated as a joint work, rather than submitting it as my individual work, we'll reconsider whether to enter together this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After checking the conditions, reconsider with your collaborator without misrepresenting it as individual work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へご希望をおつなぎします。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass your request to the coordinator. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 採尿の準備について、ご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll explain how to prepare to collect a urine sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 容器を受け取りましたが、今はまだ出ません。ほかの検査もあるので、順番をどうすればよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 採尿容器受領後に未採取で他検査との順番を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've received the container, but I can't urinate yet. I have other tests too, so I'd like to discuss the order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: After receiving the urine container, say the sample has not been collected and ask about the order with other tests. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ採取できていないことを、検査担当へ伝えます。容器はお手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll tell the testing staff that you haven't been able to collect it yet. Do you have the container with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。名前の表示も確認しました。まだ中へ何も入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容器所持氏名確認済みと中が空の状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here it is. I've checked the name label too. There is nothing inside yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have the container, checked the name, and it is empty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に確認できました。今日は先に別の検査へご案内し、その後こちらへ戻っていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've checked with the staff. Today we'll guide you to another test first, and then you'll return here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に別の検査ですね。この容器は持ったまま移動すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別検査先行案内を受け容器の運び方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Another test first, then. Should I take this container with me as I move?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After being told to do another test first, ask how to carry the container. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持参用の袋へ入れて、お手元でお持ちください。戻る場所はこの受付です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please put it in the carrying bag and keep it with you. Return to this reception desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋に入れました。戻る受付も分かりました。別の検査が終わったら、採取できる状態かここで改めて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋収納後に戻る受付を確認し終了後状態を再申告すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've put it in the bag and understand which reception to return to. After the other test, I'll tell you again here whether I'm able to collect the sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After bagging it, confirm the reception to return to and say you will report your condition again after the test. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の検査の担当へ、今の状況を申し送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on the current situation to the staff conducting the other test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。まだ採取できていないことを共有できたので、案内された順番で進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未採取の共有と担当承認順番で進むことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Now that we've shared that I haven't been able to collect it yet, I'll proceed in the order you've directed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the uncollected sample status is shared and you will follow the staff-approved order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、先の検査へご案内します。容器の袋をお持ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll guide you to the first test, then. Please bring the bag with the container. Goodbye.
